note: Set B correctly binds the reference keynotes to their named components (DISHWASHER 11 31 13.A7, CLOTHES WASHER 11 31 23.A1, PRE-FABRICATED SHOWER STALL 22 41 23.B3, HTP SUPERSTOR 22 33 00) and captures the datum elevations with the ground-plane condition. Set A has many truncated or misread values (CEILING FIN 10'-0, floor 2'-0, ceiling 10 ft), misbound attributes (INT. STEP treated as an interior-space dimension), and invented locations (Section B, intermediate plumbing line) plus bogus detail references (6, 3.A7). Set B's main flaws are an invented location for 22 41 23.B3 and 22 33 00, a garbled slope quote, and misattributing PVC to cable/hose rather than supply/waste pipe. Set A does capture the waste-pipe slope with its 2009 IRC condition and the A1 subject, which B omits or garbles, but overall B is substantially more faithful.
